evidence.controls: experiments/adc-transcript/control-results.toml SHA-256 eec2f8505eb67c5dcbc5eb038f83ef290a8ce41ea62cb4ab708668415eff2a31 pins private run group-adc-transcript-01, tested executable 00cbc04e947881cecacfde64e9162e0f408f70cc15651a9d4185605ac3b13e7a, source, fixtures and verification. Thirteen existing arms, twelve transcript arms and thirteen parser rejection cases passed. Both complete cases accepted 452 writes then stopped at main/worker next reads. Wrong value/offset/order, exhaustion, worker/W64 access and four live-input mismatches had exact expected prefixes. Full pre/post register evidence proves only PC changed for each accepted write.
evidence.transcript-contract: The parser validates bounded immutable input before target creation. Eleven live bindings, 222 table words, four source words and two initial shadow records are checked at the first main W32 candidate. Terminal ADC/SPU software captures and explicit unsupported-access events remain evidence, not device semantics. Consumer is a prefix consumer of the pinned 452-word reference within the protocol's 512 capacity. Compiled reference bytes independently match the generated fixture; stock and private profiles stay distinct.
evidence.coverage: Every new runtime arm covers two initial threads plus one observed clone, complete terminal quiescence, exact three-thread kill/reap and final no-child wait result. The ten-second deadline is checked on every runtime wait iteration, including nonempty event streams. Both frozen and stronger independent verifiers pass the same evidence; current checks bind private targets to executed ELF symbols and validated object layout. Changed binding/post-register evidence is rejected. An initial no-op mutation helper is preserved and distinguished from actual changed-evidence checks; no guest rerun was needed.
evidence.preservation: Stock application was absent throughout private controls. All 28 system_server samples were PID 1124; enforcement remained enabled. Executed binaries compare byte-for-byte with the built input. Guest and dedicated local services were stopped; stock APK/library were not modified. This conclusion is committed and pushed before the stock region experiment. No hardware behavior or acquisition is claimed.
